name: Outer Citadel
summary: The outer defensive ring of the Muramite Citadel, containing barracks, halls, and staging grounds.
description: The Outer Citadel forms the first defensive layer of the Muramite stronghold. Massive walls, fortified gatehouses, and regimented barracks dominate the landscape. Muramite soldiers train, muster, and deploy from this ring. Dragorn infiltration routes exist only in collapsed maintenance tunnels, making the Outer Citadel a brutal choke point for resistance forces.
